title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378ZU (Power to make rules)

content.overview: The Central Government may make rules for carrying out the purposes of Chapter XXIA on Producer Companies.

sections.heading: Operative rule
sections.body: The Central Government may make rules for carrying out the purposes of Chapter XXIA (Producer Companies).

sections.heading: Scope note
sections.body: Section 378ZU states a rule-making power for Chapter XXIA. The content and effect of any particular rule must be checked against the rule text and its current legal status; this section alone does not identify a specific rule or create a particular filing, remedy, penalty, or procedure.
